notes: 6 photos: 4 were menu boards. Photo 5 is a 'going cashless' notice (skipped) and photo 6 is a wide overview shot of the same screens (redundant, skipped). Dropped topping add-ons and standalone beverage prices as modifiers/drinks, not dishes; each pizza's price is its 14" Large-crust price only (other crust prices on the board omitted since only one price fits the schema).
